intent: Someone in Bridgewater, Shorehaven Village or Eastport searching for artificial turf wants to know whether their community's own association sets rules for a turf project on top of the county requirements already on this page.
distinctValue: Bridgewater (including its Shorehaven Village section) is a private, association-governed community in Little River, SC. A reader there, or in Eastport, needs their own association's current requirements on top of the county rules already on this page.

sources.label: Bridgewater: A Community of New Homes in Little River, South Carolina

notes: Eastport's only located primary source (a federal bankruptcy-court opinion, https://www.scb.uscourts.gov/MessageWebService/ViewOpinion.aspx?id=754) sets no landscaping or association rule and is not cited on the page for that reason; the page instead tells the reader to check with Eastport's own association.
